text.title: Where project-spec/ lives
text.summary: project-spec/ has one canonical location: `.aidocs/project-spec/` at the repository root, committed to git. Agents resolve it by path convention; constitution.md declares deviations only.

rule.statement: project-spec/ MUST live at `.aidocs/project-spec/` in the project repository, committed to git.
rule.rationale: A fixed path makes the spec discoverable by convention — any agent or tool finds it without reading constitution.md first. Git provides versioning, backup, review and multi-machine sync for free; a spec outside the repository lives on one machine and silently diverges.

rule.statement: The working tree keeps ONLY the current revision of every spec file — no `old/` folders, no `*-v2.md` copies, no changelog inside project-spec/.
rule.rationale: project-spec/ is the snapshot from which an identical product can be rebuilt. History belongs to git and to the feature/CR deltas under features/done/ — duplicating it inside the tree buries the current truth.

rule.statement: For a product spanning several repositories, keep ONE project-spec/ in `.aidocs/project-spec/` at the umbrella or monorepo root; nested repos MUST NOT carry their own copy.
rule.rationale: The spec describes the whole product, not one repo. Two copies means two truths; the loser drifts within weeks.

rule.statement: A project that keeps the spec anywhere else MUST declare the path in constitution.md under a "Project-spec location" heading; absence of a declaration means the canonical path applies.
rule.rationale: Legacy layouts exist. An explicit declaration keeps them navigable while the default stays zero-configuration.

antipattern.description: Keeping the canonical spec in an agent-home directory (e.g. `~/.faion/projects/<name>/`) instead of the repository.
antipattern.reason: One machine, no versioning, no backup, no review; copies on other machines diverge silently. Agent-home paths are valid as read caches or registries, never as the source of truth.

antipattern.description: project-spec/ inside a git-ignored .aidocs/ when the project is shared with multiple people or agents.
antipattern.reason: The spec disappears for everyone else. `.aidocs/` must be committed.
